question: If aPb implies a + b, aSb implies a - b, aMb implies a * b and aDb implies a ÷ b; Find the value of 5P6S3M4D8
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2091d3cebaae2d9ac49f0f4a3d14b79d4faccd8b9d4bf391771328b8ce79574e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32b32107b5da53cabbef6c73b5ded7bed5218f71312f040e081b5ffd0cfbd162.png] 

Given that 5P6S3M4D8

Putting the symbol meaning we get -

5 + 6 - 3 × 4 ÷ 8

Apply BODMAS -

5 + 6 - 3 × 0.5

5 + 6 - 1.5

11 - 1.5

9.5

Hence, **"9.5"** is the correct answer.
